scope: Final state of this bounded SRAM completion attempt, not a successful full SRAM RTL-to-GDS/signoff run.

routing.progress_scope: One PlanarRouter subpass only, not overall routing percentage.
routing.source_observation: PlanarRouter executes these network tasks in a serial loop, followed by up to five hard-coded A* passes. Public routing Config has no fast/iteration/skip field; no same-parameter repeat was launched.

scope_limits: CTS/legalization GDS is a placement-stage geometry export. It is not routed/signoff GDS and does not contain transistor-level SRAM macro geometry. Cacheless frozen results remain independent.
